assets.alt: Four fictional adult women in short bronze-blue, pearl-lilac, ruby-ivory, and emerald-cobalt RAZE looks wear gradient rainbow thigh-high stockings and heels beside the Neris in Vilnius, with Gediminas Tower rising above the riverfront.

Four fictional adult women in short bronze-teal, pearl-blue, ruby-black, and emerald-cobalt RAZE looks wear solid-color knee-high stockings and heels on the Parnidis Dune boardwalk above the Curonian Lagoon, with stylized smoke far across the water.

Four fictional adult women in short teal, gold-blue, magenta-black, and emerald RAZE looks wear rainbow knee-high stockings and pumps on a Malbun mountain terrace while two women at right share a cheek kiss and stylized smoke rises far across the valley.

Four fictional adult women in short bronze-teal, pearl-copper, ruby-black, and emerald-cobalt fashion looks wear solid knee-high stockings and pumps beside Liechtenstein's covered Old Rhine Bridge with the river and Alpine valley behind them.

caption: Lithuania ❤️ Liechtenstein: Vilnius and the Curonian dunes meet Malbun's peaks and the Old Rhine Bridge. Cheek greetings, linked hands, short metallic looks, rainbow hosiery and RAZE details. Fictional AI fashion; distant smoke is imagined.
